## Important: permission required

CareerPilot AI is currently accepting suggestions and discussion, not unsolicited code contributions.

Before submitting a pull request, obtain prior written permission from the repository owner. Pull requests submitted without that permission may be closed without merging.

If you have an idea or improvement, please open a Feature Request issue instead:
https://github.com/careerpilotAI-community/careerpilot-ai/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml

Do not include secrets, credentials, personal data, employer information, or confidential material.

## If permission was granted

- [ ] I obtained prior written permission from the repository owner.
- [ ] I described the agreed scope and purpose of this change.
- [ ] This pull request stays within the agreed scope.
- [ ] I tested the change.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, credentials, personal data, or confidential information.
